verdict.rationale: Segment supports automatic data flow triggered by events (analytics.track → destinations) and lets users build Audiences with rules based on events/traits that then sync to destinations, plus Functions for custom event-driven logic — all of which enable event-triggered automation. However, there is no dedicated 'if-this-then-that' rules/automation engine explicitly marketed for arbitrary action-triggering, and no evidence of AI-native rule authoring or agentic trigger definition. Missing for 10: an explicit rules/automation builder UI or API for defining custom trigger→action logic beyond Audiences/Functions, and any AI-native or natural-language rule creation capability.
